prompt: Design a modular Distributed Job Execution Framework in Python consisting of: (1) Master Coordinator node managing task distribution and heartbeat monitoring of workers, (2) Worker Agent executing tasks in isolated containers with CPU/memory caps, and (3) Result Aggregator collecting task outputs and managing failure retries.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Coordinator Score: 0-5 (Evaluates heartbeat tracking and task assignment logic)
Module 2 Agent Score: 0-5 (Evaluates resource bounding and execution safety)
Module 3 Aggregator Score: 0-5 (Evaluates retry policies and result collation)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates cluster resilience and network partition handling)
